       pl_insol, pl_eqt, pl_orbeccen, pl_ratror, pl_ratdor, pl_trandep,
       st_teff, st_rad, st_mass, st_met, st_logg, sy_dist, sy_pnum,
       pl_ratror_reflink, pl_ratdor_reflink, pl_trandep_reflink
